locator.section: Gloria Patri only (s01/w037–056); Holy Ghost becomes Holy Spirit

entries.claim: Historical English wording basis for the Gloria Patri only (s01/w037–056). The received formula uses Holy Spirit for the printed Holy Ghost; the other material wording is retained. This page does not supply the Introit proper, psalm verse or repeated antiphon.

locator.section: Psalm verse only (s01/w025–036); shall becomes will

entries.claim: Historical English wording basis for the psalm verse only (s01/w025–036). The retained sentence uses will in place of printed shall. This use does not attribute the new proper, expanded Gloria Patri or reprise to this page.
